observations: A wide-brimmed hat sits atop a bulbous head; olive-green and dark teal fill both forms against a flat yellow-green ground, with small pink branching shapes at the hat's upper-left edge.
Red, white, and black lines cross the face in short jagged bursts, layering over the broad color fills without following the contours of the features beneath them.
The mouth area is a compressed dark oval ringed in red, showing a row of small teeth; the two eyes are set wide and low, each a tight spiral of black lines on a dark ground.
reading: The face pushes outward — cheeks and forehead swell toward the viewer while the hat brim anchors the mass from above. Jagged white and red lines scatter across the surface like static, giving the skin a restless, uncomfortable texture. The compressed mouth and wide-set eyes read as wary or held-back. The small pink forms at the crown quietly unsettle the whole without resolving into a clear shape.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, the acid yellow-green ground here contrasts sharply with the teal field in title-neighbor nnxyz nifty faces #129. The collector links this surface-pattern quality — dense lines over flat color — to scrimshaw, a connection visible also in nnotb #55's matching ground color.

connections.reason: Both center a single large head on a flat ground, but #129 uses cool teal with smooth dark fills where #130 uses warm olive-green with dense cross-hatched color patches — a direct color-temperature contrast.

The acid yellow-green ground in nnotb #55 matches #130's background closely, and both layer short jagged lines over broader color fills in the way the collector connects to scrimshaw's incised-line quality.

lookingQuestion: Where do the jagged white and red lines follow the face's contours, and where do they cut across them regardless of what lies beneath?
ambiguities: The small pink branching forms at the upper-left of the hat are ambiguous — they may be part of the hat's decoration or a separate element; the image does not resolve this.
Title order and recorded-creation order align for this work in the owned subset, but gaps exist in the full catalogue, so no broader sequence claims are made.
